title: Millrock Technology
content: Millrock Technology is a U.S. freeze dryer and lyophilizer manufacturer serving laboratory, pilot, and production environments. Its systems are relevant to porous-material and low-temperature drying workflows, including aerogel-adjacent research where controlled solvent removal and drying optimization are important. Millrock is a useful Equipment Materials listing for teams evaluating freeze-drying capabilities in advanced materials development.
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
